title: Add NavigationArea3D and navigation layers cost map
body: Co-Author: @smix8 supersedes, and based on, #102769 Implements https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/5116 Would be affected by https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/12707, when it gets a PR Test project for this PR: [ClickToMoveTestMap.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27485893/ClickToMoveTestMap.zip) Test project created with Godot 4.6.2: [ClickToMoveTestMap-4.6.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27485896/ClickToMoveTestMap-4.6.zip) Test project for this PR: GridMap… [gridmap_area-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27485953/gridmap_area-test.zip) ## What changes * affects generated navmesh by "drawing in their own polygons", therefore affecting calculated path ([Example](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/102769#issuecomment-2710856753)) * changing an area requires re-baking * except: changing their navigation layers at runtime is possible, if you do it via NavigationRegion3D (or NavigationServer3D, though this one does not have the `bake_id`s present in mesh area nodes)! * the generated navigation mesh faces/polygons store their own navigation layers, with the region's navigation layers as their default value * replaces enter and travel cost of NavigationRegion2D/3D with new `NavigationLayersCostMap3D` resource, which is added to Agent3D/path query **travel distance, navigation layers, and the new cost map are now the travel cost variables** ## New Nodes and Resources * `NavigationLayersCostMap3D` (`Resource`) * (optional) assigned to NavigationAgend3D: different agents can have different costs per navigation layer * `NavigationMeshArea3D` (area base class. For placing nodes in the scene) * This allows agents to **prefer** walking into a certain area (collectible; vantage point; etc.) or **trying to avoid** it (environment hazards like swamp, poison, etc.). Setting the layers to `0` **stops** them from walking through this area ## Limitations * All area shapes are axis-aligned, aka cannot be randomly rotated or scaled * only polygon area can be rotated, limited to y-axis * There is a hard technical limit of 62 unique combinations of `navigation_layers` bitmasks _per navigation mesh_ * When areas overlap, the area with the highest priority applies its properties to navmesh polygons that are inside the overlap. Regions have no priority logic. probably by design of Godot: * in order for the inspector to display the cost map values you changed via code, you need to set the map once more `agent.set_navigation_layers_cost_map(agent.navigation_layers_cost_map.duplicate())` ([Source](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/102769#issuecomment-2706980169)) * _internal_ navigation layers cost map not editable during runtime via inspector ([Source](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/102769#issuecomment-2706980169)) * changes done to a separately saved navigation layers cost map during runtime via inspector persists after game stop ([Source](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/102769#issuecomment-2706980169)) ## Breaking compatibility This PR renders the region `enter_cost` and `travel_cost` _for 3D_ obsolete as well as non-functional. These costs are moved to the query with a new `NavigationLayersCostMap3D` resource and now fully build upon navigation layers. ## Possible enhancements of this PR Please leave a comment with your opinion on the following things I could add to this PR before it's merged 1. in project settings, allow changing the text size of the debug labels 2. in project settings, add option to _not_ bake debug data into navigation mesh (namely `debug_area_origins`) 3. add `_at_index` to the area methods in `NavigationRegion3D` -> this would make it equal to the naming in `NavigationServer3D` ## Examples You baked an area with navigation layers `!= 0`, but then set the navigation layers to `0` in the editor or at runtime? No walking! For anybody! Changeable at runtime! You baked an area with navigation layers `== 0`? You just punched a hole through the navigation mesh! Cannot be changed without re-baking! Layers of navigation area (layers: 4) and the agent (layers: 1, 2, 3) don't match? No walking for you: Yes, we match… But… Too expensive! You can also lure an agent in by being cheap: simple detour for NPC to a power up! You use nodes and want to see area names in the 3d scene? debug build? Use them when changing area navigation layers at runtime? Here you go with `bake_id` in `NavigationMeshArea3D` nodes: gridmap works. (except with debug label position at runtime). gridmap's design doesn't make this feature as useful, except you have unique tiles. ## Post-PR Care ### Update thirdparty Recast Godot's Recast is outdated * in Godot, `SAMPLE_PARTITION_LAYERS` does not support areas, see https://github.com/recastnavigation/recastnavigation/pull/470 ### NavigationObstacle3D The navmesh carving logic in `NavigationObstacle3D` can be fully removed (under the hood, it's basically areas logic anyway). With that change, obstacles are back to being used for avoidance only. Makes everything more consistent. New proposal should be opened. ### New Plugin - Design Concept that could improve usability (should be posted in a new proposal): Showing a panel at the bottom which allows searching, filtering and managing areas of the currently selected NavigationRegion3D. design details * probably best to put into dock at the bottom and show if a NavigationRegion3D is selected * above everything, show navigation layers of region (for reference) * area filtering control: * a bitmask control for filtering ares -> filter by enabled bitfield with further filtering option "must match (all enabled bitfields)" and "match any (enabled bitfield)" * an input field for filtering by area ID * add an "area"-picker. pick an area in the 3d editor. if a match is found, auto-scroll in editor to the correct entry and highlight it (briefly by blinking) * a bitmask control for updating the area's navigation layer (the only thing we have in the current simplest implementation) * next to it, add a focus button. to move the camera to that spot/area (lookat-logic) * changes the color of the corresponding debug mesh faces ## Tips ### supporting vertically stacked floors [Video Demo](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/102769#issuecomment-2694019258) check for `is_target_reachable() == false` and use `NavigationPathQueryResult3D`, `path_rids` (and including the last path node if it's a `PATH_SEGMENT_TYPE_LINK`): By running the pathfinding again with an Agent that can use all navigation layers, you get a path that reaches the target. Then read `NavigationPathQueryResult3D` and check for the first waypoint that's on an navigation area (or link) the original Agent is not allowed to trespass on. ## TODOs * [x] deprecate travel/enter costs in 3D * [x] re-evaluate class docs. add info from comments of original PR * [x] add server methods to achieve these things w/o nodes and resources * ~~add debug gizmo rendering when creating area via server~~ * gizmos are for editor, not runtime/build. and for as long as the `NavigationMesh` resource does not save the shape type, the polygons won't know what is what * [x] delete commented code * [x] Cannot bake area node if on nav layer 1 ([Source](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/102769#issuecomment-2706980169)) * [x] Crash during baking of very specific workflow ([Source](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/102769#issuecomment-2703886248)) * [x] debug view in project build does not render area faces differently when the "random color" option in the project settings is turned off * [x] tempory mesh holes should look differently: no face mesh or fully transparent * [x] areas in region3d's inspector are not cleared when the navmesh is cleared * debug navmesh area face coloring * debug navmesh area face colors are not adjusting when their navigation layers equal region's layers * [x] runtime * [x] editor: still looking for a way to pass this through from inspector to debug mesh * [x] when area's navigation layer is incompatible with agent's navigation layers, discard them during pathfinding query * [x] print error when baking a region with layers == 0 * [x] projected areas that fail to affect the navmesh baking still end up in the navmesh resource * [x] check if this is an issue: there's no `safe_scale` like in `NavigationMeshAreaBox3D::_update_bounds` or `NavigationMeshArea3D::navmesh_parse_source_geometry`. * [x] resolve code marked with TODO/FIXME * [x] mono pipeline issue: rebase code to latest * label gizmos over every area, the text being the area index * [x] editor * [x] runtime * [x] improve position.y value * ~~the internal Label3D nodes are probably saved to the scene…? prevent, if possible~~ * the saved scene file looked clean * [x] the indices returned from `add_projected_area_*` funcs (in geometry source) do not necessarily correspond to the baked indices -> bring back internal (persistent) area IDs in server/navmesh + add a `String baking_id` (must be unique per navmesh) to mesh area nodes to ease dynamic updates at runtime (navmesh saves a mapping of area id to bake id) * [x] cover mesh area node's baking id in server test * [x] Handling compatibility breakages * [x] going below or fly ([Source](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/102769#issuecomment-2692702548)) * [x] bug: agent can walk over nav links with incompatible navigation layers * [x] general testing
